text:
Julia: Hi all — addressed the review comments on PR #4512 (db-migrate: split + backfill). PTAL when you have a minute. Summary: split migration into two steps, added a short backfill that uses a guarded batch, added a unit + small e2e that exercises the race we saw. Local smoke runs ~40s. I also reverted the experimental flag per @Sam's suggestion. Aiming to merge before tomorrow's canary (10:00am PT). If anyone needs more time, please say so.

Sam: thanks, looking now.

Sam: small thing — can we bump the default timeout in migration util from 30s -> 60s and add a one-line comment about the race window? I hit a flake locally when my VM was busy.

Julia: done — pushed a commit that changes the timeout and adds the comment + a brief note in CHANGELOG. PTAL.

Max: I pulled the branch and ran the backfill locally against a copy of prod-ish data. Behavior looks correct. The e2e you added exercised the scenario and cleaned up as expected.

code-review-bot: CI: postgres-12 / integration-long failed on job step 'fixtures-setup' (flaky). Rerun requested by Julia.

Taylor: quick ops note — can we keep the migration and backfill commits separate (don't squash)? Ops/audit team prefers the migration vs backfill history visible. If that's OK, please leave separate commits when merging.

Julia: 👍 yes, will not squash.

code-review-bot: CI rerun passed: postgres-12 / integration-long succeeded. All required checks green now.

Sam: approving now — LGTM. Thanks for addressing the timeout and comment.

Max: left one optional suggestion (naming nit) but not blocking. LGTM from me as well.

Julia: thanks everyone — merging in the 10:00am canary slot unless someone objects by 9:45am PT. If anything unexpected pops up in canary I'll open a rollback PR and ping eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
